body: Filed 2026-09-24 after the 0.8.0 release. docs/GLOSSARY.md:80 cites `docs/specs/mcp-server-2026-07-28-v0.md:178` for the MCP bridge result enum REPOSITORY_EVIDENCE/GIT_REPOSITORY/NONE. Line 178 is the serverInfo name; the authorityClass enum is at line 234. The citation carries no content hash, so line-citations-check does not catch the drift.
title: docs: GLOSSARY cites mcp-server spec line 178 for authorityClass; the enum is at line 234
